explain.real: Your screenshot goes into the device slot as it is.
explain.simplify: It is cropped to the focus area, sensitive parts are hidden and the main panel is redrawn with the interface kit.
explain.redraw: The interface kit stands for what the product does; your screenshot is not shown as pixels. It is never an AI-made mockup.

notice.redrawShown: This screen is to be redrawn, so it should not appear as pixels; the scene has to be re-planned.
notice.notShown: Your choice is saved. For this screen to appear in the film the scene has to be re-planned.

errors.conflict: The plan changed elsewhere. The latest version was read; choose again.
errors.failed: The choice could not be saved. Try again.
errors.unavailable: The promo film plan is turned off in this environment.
